masthead.label: SUCCESSION
masthead.h1: A permanent home for the businesses that deserve to continue.
masthead.lede: When an owner is ready to step back, we provide a permanent home: we keep the name, the people, and the relationships. We are operators, not a fund. There is no exit plan, because there is no exit.

japan.name: Japan
japan.subtitle: 事業承継
japan.description: Our flagship program, based in Yokohama. For owners considering succession, their families, and their advisors.

further.body: The same model, market by market, in time. New Zealand — where the group began — has its own generation of retiring owners.
